intended_use: define safety and regulated cost-structure concepts
rationale: Primary legal text; suitable for legal and cost-structure context, not realized driver economics.

intended_use: define 2022 tariff-zone regime
rationale: Primary legal text for the 2022 passenger-motorcycle tariff regime.

intended_use: define application-use/support-fee regulatory reference from 2022-11-22
rationale: JDIH provides the normative benchmark within covered passenger-motorcycle scope; normative ceilings remain distinct from observed deductions.

intended_use: support May 2026 policy-announcement chronology
rationale: Official presidential communication establishes an announcement layer but not complete operative legal text.

intended_use: support planned 8% implementation chronology for named two-wheel passenger services
rationale: Official DPR communication is implementation evidence rather than transaction evidence.

intended_use: support August 2026 regulatory-status reconciliation
rationale: Official status update demonstrates continuing finalization/harmonization for broader service scope.

intended_use: treat KP-PHB 532/2026 as authoritative legal fee rule
rationale: Multiple sources corroborate references to KP-PHB 532/2026 but the primary legal text and full scope/calculation base remain unverified.

intended_use: record inDrive stated 8% commission policy
rationale: Documents a company-stated implementation layer rather than universal realized deduction.

intended_use: use BKT annual report as quantitative ATP/WTP evidence
rationale: The annual report confirms the study existed but does not provide sufficient respondent methodology or metric definitions for quantitative use.

intended_use: use Polling Institute 2022 driver income and service distributions
rationale: Primary report content documents 810 drivers across 31 kabupaten/kota using multistage random sampling; daily income wording remains source-defined and national representativeness should not be overstated.

intended_use: support logged-in-hours and work-related-cost definitions
rationale: Fairwork 2022 is useful for process and methodological cost/time concepts but its small purposive worker interviews are non-representative.

intended_use: estimate national driver earnings distribution
rationale: Fairwork worker interviews are not designed to estimate population prevalence.

intended_use: cross-check platform practices and fair-pay/work-cost treatment in 2025
rationale: Fairwork Indonesia 2025 is Jakarta-based and purposive; it supports process evidence rather than national prevalence.

intended_use: use IDEAS 2025/2026 primary brief for aggregate driver economics
rationale: Primary brief provides gross earnings, orders, distance, workdays, source-reported hours, deduction brackets and bonuses; locality count is internally inconsistent and operating-cost bundle includes food/drink.

intended_use: use IDEAS source-reported net income as project net operating earnings
rationale: The source operating-cost bundle includes personal food/drink and therefore does not match the project operating-cost boundary.

intended_use: use driver-reported deduction brackets
rationale: Deduction brackets are self-reported responses rather than matched transaction-level realized deductions.

intended_use: inflation-adjust province-level nominal monetary observations from 2025
rationale: Official BPS CPI supports transparent real-value transformation when geography and period match.

intended_use: inflation-adjust city-level nominal monetary observations from 2025
rationale: Official BPS city CPI is preferred where the observation city is covered.

intended_use: use INDEF-PPPI survey as national population estimate of driver economics
rationale: Survey components use purposive sampling despite national geographic scope.

intended_use: use INDEF-PPPI driver survey for sample-level ecosystem comparisons
rationale: Primary report supports sample-level perception and ecosystem analysis; purposive sampling and metric definitions constrain generalization.

intended_use: use INDEF-PPPI CGE outputs as driver unit-economics observations
rationale: CGE outputs are modelled ecosystem effects rather than driver-level observed earnings or costs.

intended_use: use Litbang Kompas gross daily earnings distribution
rationale: Secondary reporting provides useful categories but final sample count and original sampling frame remain unresolved.

intended_use: derive project net earnings by subtracting article-mentioned food and fuel costs
rationale: Food is outside the project operating-cost boundary and cannot be bundled into driver operating costs.

intended_use: use reported daily/weekly working hours
rationale: Working hours are relevant but online versus productive-hour meaning is not established.

intended_use: treat driver desired commission rate as observed realized deduction
rationale: Preference or perception does not measure actual transaction deductions.

intended_use: use driver fairness perceptions as context
rationale: Useful for attitudes but not unit-economics measurement.

intended_use: support association between driver characteristics/workload and income in Jabodetabek
rationale: Local questionnaire study can support association analysis if source-defined variables are retained; no causal or national inference is warranted.

intended_use: generalize Jabodetabek results nationally
rationale: Local study cannot establish national population effects.

intended_use: combine sources into pooled earnings estimate
rationale: Current evidence spans normative rules surveys secondary summaries local studies and official indexes; pooling depends on metric-level compatibility.

intended_use: corroborate IDEAS methodology and geographic coverage
rationale: Author-linked article corroborates purposive sampling and sample size but does not replace primary brief tables.

intended_use: model or benchmark fuel cost for observations in July 2026
rationale: Product geography and effective date are sufficiently explicit for cautious modelling; Pertamax varies regionally.

intended_use: apply one national Pertamax price to all July 2026 driver observations
rationale: Regional Pertamax price variation makes a single national value inappropriate.

intended_use: treat Perpres 27/2026 as an already published operative legal text as of 2026-08-27
rationale: Official August status reporting indicated the broader online-transport rule remained under finalization/harmonization and no operative text was verified by the retrieval date.

intended_use: interpret Fairwork interview evidence as process/policy verification rather than population prevalence
rationale: Fairwork methodology explicitly describes non-representative worker recruitment and small per-platform interview samples.

intended_use: use ANTARA report as Polling Institute methodology corroboration
rationale: Contemporaneous reporting corroborates fieldwork period sample size geography sampling method and reported margin of error.

intended_use: use INDEF-PPPI companion presentation for sample-level perceptions
rationale: Presentation shares the purposive-sample limitations of the underlying study and does not establish realized deductions.

intended_use: use Grab maximum 8% statement as platform-stated implementation evidence
rationale: Company statement documents the platform-stated layer rather than transaction-level realized deduction.

intended_use: use GrabBike Hemat processing timing as deduction-rate evidence
rationale: Processing timing and deduction rate are analytically distinct.

intended_use: separate GoSend customer application fee from driver travel fare
rationale: The fee definition is useful within GoSend but cannot automatically be generalized to other Gojek services.

intended_use: use average expenditure as project operating cost
rationale: The expenditure definition is too broad without component decomposition.

intended_use: use KP 564/2022 as historical regulatory reference
rationale: JDIH verifies the historical instrument; it lists regulated cost components and a 20% application-use fee ceiling but was later amended and revoked.

intended_use: use IDEAS 2023 aggregate driver economics
rationale: Jabodetabek purposive sample supports local descriptive evidence; retrospective historical values are not independent survey waves.

intended_use: use IDEAS 2020 aggregate driver economics
rationale: Jabodetabek purposive sample supports historical local descriptive evidence; metric denominators must remain source-specific.

intended_use: treat IDEAS 2020 2023 and 2025 as a directly comparable longitudinal series
rationale: Sample coverage recruitment and some definitions differ across the three briefs; any cross-period comparison requires metric-level audit and explicit caveats.
